title: All the magic
image_alt: Expressive mixed-media architectural work by Adi Schmölzer
summary: A vivid encounter between drawn signs, architectural fragments and saturated fields of colour.

title: Auf Linien zum Leben
image_alt: Hand-drawn poster for the seventh Spittaler Comicfestival
summary: Comics, cartoons, illustration and outsider art meet an open, participatory drawing studio for all ages.
description: Under the theme ‘Life stories – from tragedy to comedy’, visitors are invited to turn experiences, thoughts and texts into images. The festival combines an exhibition with daily workshops and a growing display of work created on site.
medium: Comics, illustration, outsider art and workshops

title: Verwandlung und Zustand
image_alt: Abstract painting in blue, turquoise and ochre by Nicoline von Heyl
summary: Process-led painting searches for the essential image through expressive surfaces, reduction and concentrated colour.
description: Nicoline von Heyl lives and works in Krumpendorf am Wörthersee. Her work moves between portrait and figure studies and non-representational, process-based painting. During the exhibition, the artist works on site in an open studio.

title: Begegnungen – Kunst öffnet Türen
image_alt: Abstract work with red and dark forms by Lebenshilfe Spittal
summary: An exhibition built around encounter, creative access and the capacity of art to open doors.

title: Farbe trifft Struktur
image_alt: Layered architectural painting by Herbert Meißlitzer
summary: Colour and architectural structure overlap in a densely worked view of place and memory.

title: Farben im Park
image_alt: Paintings of lemons and a figure by Sylvia Campidell and Judith Maria Kulle
summary: Two painterly positions bring figures, plants and the vivid chromatic life of the park into dialogue.

title: African Heart
image_alt: Portrait of an African buffalo used for Birgit Mörtl’s exhibition African Heart
summary: A direct, attentive look at animal presence and the visual force of the African landscape.

title: Gehen & Sehen
image_alt: Watercolour of a group of elongated figures seen from behind in red, ochre and blue by Peter Kohlweiß
summary: Watercolours and drawings made from walking attentively and looking at what nature and architecture offer.
description: Peter Kohlweiß has painted since 1982, beginning with Professor Hans Picottini at the HTL Villach and continuing through courses and seminars until he found his own style. He works in watercolour and drawing, translating what he sees on walks into pencil, brush and colour on paper and canvas.

title: Das, was entsteht
image_alt: Comic illustration of three exaggerated characters in a desert setting by Santino Solace
summary: Comics, manga and webtoon work built around invented characters, stories and imagined worlds.
description: Santino Solace lives and works in Spittal an der Drau as a comic artist, illustrator and founder of the creative platform SolaceWorks. His work combines manga, comics and modern digital illustration in a personal, humorous narrative style. The exhibition offers insight into his projects, working processes and the development of his own worlds.
